name: Lawn care (recurring mowing)
summary: Recurring mowing stops priced per visit from turf, edging, beds and drive time.

items.label: Turf mowing
items.source: 10,000 sq ft at 20,000 sq ft/h (index.html default row; SERVICE_PRESETS in calc.mjs); no per-unit material in the specialist

items.label: Edging and blowing
items.source: 25 minutes at 60 minutes/h (index.html default row); no material in the specialist

items.label: Bed weeding / detail
items.source: 350 sq ft at 400 sq ft/h (index.html default row; SERVICE_PRESETS); no material in the specialist

items.label: Drive time and fuel
items.source: 18 min one way x 2 = 0.6 h per visit (oneWayMinutes, index.html); fuel $8 per visit (fuelPerVisit). The specialist uses minutes, not miles

items.label: Equipment share
items.source: Equipment share $40/month / (1 visit/week x 52/12 weeks) = $9.231 per visit (index.html, WEEKS_PER_MONTH in calc.mjs)

specialistModels: Prices the route as a monthly in-season contract with annual and 12-month smoothed totals, per-acre and per-visit checks, and a proposed-price margin test.
